landing.hero: Your business, organized — with AI that actually helps.
landing.description: Track ideas, finance, trading, research, decisions and more — all in one place, with an AI assistant that understands your data and helps you think it through. No more scattered notes, spreadsheets, and chat windows.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade whenever you need more credits, AI agents, or team seats.
pricing.teamBannerBody: Invite teammates to work directly inside your workspace — every member gets full access at your plan's tier, not a limited guest view. On Professional, add members for +{price}/member/month, billed monthly per seat. Ultimate and Enterprise include unlimited team seats at no extra charge, so your whole team joins for free. Manage invites and remove access anytime from the Team page in Settings.
pricing.businessExplanation: Choose Professional or Ultimate as your base plan — both unlock team collaboration. Then invite team members: each one gets full access at your plan's tier, for +{price}/member/month on Professional, or included free on Ultimate.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.subtitle: Ionexa AI is being built in phases. Here's what's live today, what's coming next, and where we're headed.
